Definition: Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mesha is named once, among the sons Shaharaim begat of Hodesh his wife, beside Jobab and Zibia and Malcham. The name covers both a place in Arabia and a man of Benjamin, and here it is the man, in the genealogy of Benjamin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy keeps Mesha because every name in Benjamin's line mattered to the tribe that kept it, even the ones we know nothing else about.
